translation: Mi corazón ⟨se⟩ ardió en mi interior; mientras meditaba ⟨el⟩ fuego se encendió; entonces hablé con mi lengua

tokens.rationale: חם (hot) used figuratively for intense emotion, requires auxiliary verb in English
לבי literally 'my heart', figurative center of emotion/thought
בקרבי literally 'in my inward parts', idiom for inner being
HAPAX בהגיגי, from הגה (meditate/ponder), describes inner mental process
תבער (kindle/burn) with feminine subject אש (fire), requires article in English
אש (fire) used figuratively for intense emotion/inspiration
בלשוני literally 'with my tongue', idiom for spoken words
